test_mjx_smooth_functions: test MJX smooth functions (kinematics, com_pos, camlight, crb, factor_m, com_vel, rne) match MuJoCo equivalents
test_mjx_disable_gravity: test MJX rne function with gravity disabled returns zero bias forces
test_mjx_site_transmission: test MJX transmission function with site-based actuators matches MuJoCo actuator_length and actuator_moment
test_mjx_subtree_vel: test MJX subtree_vel function matches MuJoCo mj_subtreeVel for subtree_linvel and subtree_angmom
test_mjx_rne_postconstraint: test MJX rne_postconstraint function matches MuJoCo mj_rnePostConstraint with connect and weld equality constraints
test_mjx_tendon_variants: test MJX tendon function across multiple tendon configurations (fixed, pulley, wrap, site) matches MuJoCo mj_tendon
test_mjx_tendon_armature: test MJX tendon_armature and tendon_bias functions with dense and sparse Jacobian types match MuJoCo
